name: Savings Account
description: Earns compound interest every minute. Primary key deposits the emerald in your hand, secondary key withdraws one, sneak + secondary freezes the account.
fields: long coins = 0;              // whole coins, always rounded down
double fraction = 0.0;       // the part below one coin, carried between periods
double streakBonus = 0.0;    // extra rate for unbroken periods
long lastBalance = 0;        // coins before this period's interest
// milestones: once true, they stay true
boolean bigDepositor = false; // 64 emeralds deposited in total
